dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your sales pitch is pretty interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Katia
dialogues.text: Oh my, thank you kindly! That means you have a gift for seeing the good in others, and a sharp eye besides!

dialogues.speaker: Katia
dialogues.text: Good people deserve good news! And wouldn't you know it, today's paper is full of excellent news. So, would you care for a newspaper?
